validator_checklist: All380 point IDs unique; JSON source_sha256/path/index must resolve to frozen source records.
Exclude only the48 F self-reference rows from WP2; preserve every QR33/QR4 row, failure/NA included.
Check exact rational x=W/(H+1), then plot log(c) via axis transformation only; never substitute W/p or an effective-sample interpretation.
Use v8 relative_loss_percent, v9 full_procedure_relative_loss_percent, empirical saved relative_loss_percent; do not recompute/round source y for plotting.
Verify each row method/H/W/DGP/phi/volatility/source and complete counts; retain source statuses even if unplottable.
Retain120 old empirical rows and20 new learning-curve rows; eight duplicates are one same-period FX task with repeated evidence, not independent validation.
Keep every coincident-x record; no averaging, outcome-based deduplication, jittering true x or dropped zero/negative point.
Use the original WP1 all-draw envelope by method; identify it as post-hoc/fixed-grid uncertainty and preserve a nonmonotone/first-cutpoint caveat.
Axis limits must contain every finite point and band; no outlier crop/percentile clip. If a detail inset is used, retain a full-range panel.
Verify plotted offsets against manifest, expected collections/markers/panels, output PNG/PDF existence and rendered visibility, and route every point to a specificsource row.
